_note: Short do and don't lines compiled into each project's generated AGENTS.md block. universal always applies; a tag's lines apply when engine/project.py detects that tag. Keep each line under 140 characters: the whole block is capped (project_block in harness-budgets.json) and tag lines are dropped from the end when it is over.

do: Run the test command above before saying a change works, and report its real output.
Reproduce a bug with a failing test before fixing it.
Confirm a package exists in its registry before importing it.
Keep each change limited to what the task asked for.
dont: Don't build SQL, shell commands or HTML by joining strings with input.
Don't put keys, tokens or passwords in source, tests or logs.
Don't add AI attribution to commits or pull requests.
Don't refactor or reformat code the task did not touch.

do: Await every promise and give every outbound call a timeout.
Install from the lockfile and keep it committed.
dont: Don't pass input to child_process.exec; use execFile or spawn with an argument array.

do: Type external input as unknown and narrow it at the boundary.
dont: Don't use any or a non-null assertion to silence the compiler.

do: Derive values during render; keep effects for syncing with things outside React.
dont: Don't use an array index as the key of a list that reorders or filters.

do: Use the project's environment tool and annotate public function signatures.
dont: Don't use a bare except, a mutable default argument, or shell=True.

do: Return Result and propagate with ?; run cargo clippy before finishing.
dont: Don't unwrap or expect on input from outside the program.

do: Use try-with-resources and preserve the cause when wrapping an exception.
dont: Don't return null for a collection or catch Exception broadly.

do: Run blocking I/O on Dispatchers.IO inside a scope the caller owns.
dont: Don't swallow CancellationException or use !! without a stated reason.

do: Wrap errors with %w and check them with errors.Is.
Pin base image versions and run as a non-root user.
dont: Don't put secrets in ENV, ARG or copied files.

do: Parameterize every query and review the lock each migration statement takes.
dont: Don't deploy code that needs a column before its migration has run.

do: Give workflows the minimum permissions and install from the lockfile.
dont: Don't hide a failing step with continue-on-error.
